paper_metadata.title: Tailoring nanoprecipitates to achieve ultrahigh strength (CoCrNi)94.5W3Ta2.5 medium-entropy alloys

evidence.quote: a novel ultra-strong (CoCrNi)94.5W3Ta2.5 medium entropy alloy (MEA) with dual nanoprecipitates is successfully developed
